function.name: FPG_ADD
function.param: Code of the library to modify
Code for the new graph, interval 0-999
function.abstract: Add a new graph to FPG (Library Graphics File) on memory

description.p: This function allows to modify a FPG library on memory, adding a new graph from other graph which is on memory.

The destiny library must be the code of a FPG library obtained by the functions or . The source library must be the code of other library on on memory, although it can identify the own destiny library (to do copies of graphs within the same one) or the 0 library, to can specify graphs obtained with functions like .

FPG_ADD create a copy of the original graph, which it is valid and accessible. If there is a graph with the same code in the destiny library, this will be eliminated of memory and replaced by the new graph.
The major utility of this function is create new libraries of graphs to save after with . Other functions allow to modify the parameters in memory of the graphs added to the library, like .

function.note: All graphs added to the same library must have the same depth of colour (1, 8 or 16 bits). Add a graph to a library when there is a graph of other type will return an error.
